True from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    if not counts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    maxr = max(r for r, c in shape)
    maxc = max(c for r, c in shape)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Stamp the rare-color stencil wherever every stencil cell is zero
    # in the original grid. Do not use newly painted cells to qualify a stamp.
    for r in range(h-maxr):
        for c in range(w-maxc):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
